title: What If You Could Breathe Underwater, But Never Come Back Up?

scenes.notes: STORY wide, split waterline: `explainer/Ocean` `surface: 0.35`, dusk `skyTop` violet / `skyBottom` orange; NEW `whatif/Ferry` slides right->left along the waterline with a lit deck rail; `You` `pose: panic` just under the surface in a `particles` bubbles burst; HUD from frame 1 (DEPTH 0 M, BODY 37.0); `Tag` WESTERN PACIFIC
STORY medium underwater: Bubbles gone; `You` relaxes to `pose: stand`, floating upright (`idle` float); a slow chest-rise `svg` arc pulses (`idle` breathe); light from above flickers
STORY medium, companion intro: NEW `whatif/Fish` `species: remora` (~0.6 m, shared `pxPerM`) swims in from the left and latches on between `You`'s shoulders; HUD REMORA chip `ATTACHED` pops

STORY wide, split waterline (POV stand-in): The 0:00 split frame again: the `whatif/Ferry` shrinks by keyframes (scale 1 -> 0.35) while tiny deck-rail `circle` heads stay lit; `You` small below the waterline with the remora
STORY medium, rule beat: `You` reaches up toward the bright surface line; a red `rect` strike draws across the surface (the one-way rule); `Tag` AIR: DOESN'T WORK FOR YOU
GRAPHIC map + stat: `Stat` 4,000 M TO THE FLOOR; then `explainer/Map` inset (western Pacific, zoom 3): pin YOU, dashed 300 KM line, pin CHALLENGER DEEP

GRAPHIC full-height ruler (route): HUD `focus: route`: the DepthMeter grows to full frame height, `max: 11000`; route marks light one by one 200 · 1,000 · 2,000 · 4,000 · **8,200 (red, THE WALL?)** · 10,935 (kit edit: DepthMeter `marks`)
STORY vertical descent: `You` rotated head-down (`rotate: 160`, `pose: run` as a kick) with the remora on its back; Ocean `depth` track starts (HUD meter leaves 0 for good)
